defs.def: an organized set of ideas or theories or a particular way of doing sth （思想或理论）体系；方法；制度；体制

ex.s: Collect samples of plant root systems.
ex.t: 收集植物根系的样本。

ex.s: The result—an approach known as systems thinking—is now seen as essential in meeting global challenges.
ex.t: 结果——一种被称为系统思维的方法——现在被视为应对全球挑战的关键。

ex.s: But as some researchers find, the food system is not an equal one.
ex.t: 但正如一些研究者发现的，食物系统并不是一个平等的体系。

ex.s: More researchers, policymakers and representatives from the food industry must learn to look beyond their direct lines of responsibility and adopt a systems approach.
ex.t: 更多研究者、政策制定者和食品行业代表必须学会超越其直接责任范围，并采用系统方法。

ex.s: Before the heavy lifting began, the team assessed the root system and dug a five-foot-deep cylinder , measuring 40 feet in diameter, around the trunk to protect all essential roots.
ex.t: 在重型吊装开始前，团队先评估了根系，并在树干周围挖了一个深五英尺、直径40英尺的圆柱形坑，以保护所有重要的根部。

ex.s: “Wax is a complex mixture, but the basic bond in polyethylene, the carbon-carbon bond, is there as well,” she explains, “The wax worm evolved a method or system to break this bond.”
ex.t: “蜡是一种复杂的混合物，但聚乙烯中的基本键——碳碳键——也在其中，”她解释说，“蜡虫进化出了一种方法来破坏这种键。”

ex.s: Policymakers should start thinking now about how to make sure the appearance of driverless vehicles doesn’t extend the worst aspects of the car-controlled transportation system we have today.
ex.t: 政策制定者现在就应该开始思考，如何确保无人驾驶车辆的出现不会放大我们今天这种以汽车为主导的交通体系中最糟糕的方面。

ex.s: New ways of measuring time can help to control Earth systems．
ex.t: 测量时间的新方法可以帮助控制地球系统。

defs.def: a group of things, pieces of equipment, etc. that are connected or work together 系统

ex.s: Alvaro Luna, a professor of electrical engineering, said that the system is innovative in so far as it allows for recycled energy to be redirected to specific local uses — in this case powering electric cars parked nearby.
ex.t: 电气工程教授Alvaro Luna表示，该系统的创新之处在于它能让回收的能量转向特定的本地用途——在这里就是为停在附近的电动汽车供电。

ex.s: What did Luna say about the system?
ex.t: 卢娜对这个系统说了什么？

ex.s: Scientists at Salk Institute are making use of the natural capacity of plants to absorb carbon dioxide by enhancing their root systems.
ex.t: 萨尔克研究所的科学家正在利用植物吸收二氧化碳的自然能力，通过增强其根系来实现这一目标。

ex.s: Restaurants like Silo in the UK have experimented with zero-waste systems, but wastED took the concept to its logical conclusion.
ex.t: 像英国 Silo 这样的餐厅已尝试过零浪费系统，但 wastED 采取了更进一步的方式……

ex.s: To improve the UK’s zero-waste systems.
ex.t: 为了改进英国的零废弃系统。

ex.s: The pronunciation system of the Chinese language is quite different from that of English.
ex.t: 汉语的语音系统与英语的语音系统大不相同。

ex.s: BMF is an indoor garden system.
ex.t: BMF是一套室内园艺系统。

ex.s: Because the system is automated, it significantly reduces the amount of water needed to grow plants.
ex.t: 由于系统是自动化的，它大大减少了种植植物所需的水量。

ex.s: Rather than watering rows of soil, the system provides just the right amount to each plant.
ex.t: 系统不是浇灌一排排土壤，而是为每株植物提供恰到好处的水量。

ex.s: How did the national park system come about?
ex.t: 国家公园系统是如何形成的？

ex.s: The mechanism involves a repurposed reward system originally used to develop habits important for self-care.
ex.t: 这一机制涉及一种被重新利用的奖励系统，该系统原本用于培养对自我照顾很重要的习惯。

ex.s: Our brains use the system to acquire behavioural patterns regarding safe routes home, efficient food gathering and dangers to avoid.
ex.t: 我们的大脑利用这一系统习得有关安全回家路线、高效觅食以及需要避开的危险的行为模式。

ex.s: Then you let these new systems develop their own ways to self-repair.”
ex.t: 然后你让这些新系统发展出自我修复的方式。”

ex.s: As Kristian Hammond, professor of electrical engineering and computer science at Northwestern University, put it: “There’s never a stage at which the system knows what it’s talking about.”
ex.t: 正如西北大学电气工程与计算机科学教授克里斯蒂安·哈蒙德所言：系统从来没有一个阶段知道自己到底在说什么。

ex.s: “The existence of a living system is not about the use of anything.” Alan says.
ex.t: 生命系统的存在并不关乎对任何东西的利用，艾伦说。

ex.s: This is the capacity for a system to create essentially endless complexity, to be a sort of “novelty generator”.
ex.t: 这是一种系统创造近乎无限复杂性的能力，成为某种"新颖性生成器"。

ex.s: The only system known to exhibit this is Earth’s biosphere.
ex.t: 已知唯一能展示这种能力的系统是地球的生物圈。

ex.s: All the assignments will be submitted by the assigned date through Blackboard, our online learning and course management system.
ex.t: 所有作业必须在指定日期前通过Blackboard提交，这是我们的在线学习和课程管理系统。

ex.s: It is a complex and dynamic system.
ex.t: 它是一个复杂而动态的系统。

ex.s: With help from Tesla, Westinghouse's firm developed a system using alternating current, which soon became the major forms of power delivery.
ex.t: 在特斯拉的帮助下，Westinghouse 的公司开发了一种使用交流电的系统，很快成为电力输送的主要形式。

ex.s: The first objective of systems thinking hasn’t been achieved.
ex.t: 系统思维的第一个目标尚未达成。

ex.s: As for systems thinking, which would the author agree with?
ex.t: 关于系统思维，作者会同意哪种说法？

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 每张鸭票所筹的每一美元中，约有98美分直接汇入候鸟保护基金，用于购置湿地和野生动物栖息地，并将其纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保了这片土地将受到保护，并为子孙后代所用。

ex.s: The National Wildlife Refuge System
ex.t: 国家野生动物保护区系统

ex.s: A computer system will analyze the video to determine whether a cow is sick.
ex.t: 一个计算机系统将分析视频，判断一头牛是否生病。

ex.s: To call for the modernization of public library systems.
ex.t: 介绍公共图书馆改进后的服务。

ex.s: A flexible system.
ex.t: 一个灵活的系统。

ex.s: These systems are sometimes faster and more perceptive than we humans are.
ex.t: 这些系统有时比我们人类更快、更敏锐。

ex.s: But so far that is only true for the specific tasks for which the systems have been designed.
ex.t: 但到目前为止，这仅适用于那些系统被专门设计来完成的特定任务。

ex.s: But all of today's excited discussion about these possibilities presupposes the fact that we will be able to build these systems.
ex.t: 但今天关于这些可能性的所有兴奋讨论，都预设了我们将能够建造这些系统这一事实。

ex.s: To replace the password system.
ex.t: 替换密码系统。

ex.s: （5）How does an early﹣warning system help us maintain the ecological balance？
ex.t: （5）预警系统如何帮助我们维持生态平衡？

ex.s: The road novel, the road movie, these are the most typical American ideas, born of abundant petrol, cheap cars and a never-ending interstate highway system, the largest public works project in history.
ex.t: 公路小说、公路电影，这些是最典型的美国观念，诞生于充足的汽油、便宜的汽车和永无止境的洲际高速公路系统——史上最大的公共工程。

ex.s: To praise the effectiveness of America’s road system.
ex.t: 赞扬美国道路系统的有效性。

ex.s: （2）What do the automatic fire alarm systems include？
ex.t: （2）自动火灾报警系统包括什么？

ex.s: But the most sensible form of adaptation is surely to adapt our energy systems to emit less carbon pollution.
ex.t: 但最明智的适应方式无疑是调整我们的能源系统以减少碳排放。

ex.s: Gong Bao Chicken (also known as Kung Pao Chicken) was originally a family dish of Ding Baozhen, or Ding Gongbao, a high-ranking court official of the Qing Dynasty who helped reconstruct the Dujiangyan Irrigation System in Chengdu, Sichuan.
ex.t: 宫保鸡丁（又名Kung Pao Chicken）原本是丁宝桢（又名丁宫保）的家常菜，他是清朝的一位高级官员，曾帮助重建四川成都的都江堰水利工程。

ex.s: It's good for our digestive system.
ex.t: 这对我们的消化系统有好处。

ex.s: It has a complex landscape that includes great gorges, waterfalls and caves systems, pockets of rainforest and a large variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 它拥有复杂的地貌，包括大峡谷、瀑布和洞穴系统、零星的热带雨林以及种类繁多的野生动物。

ex.s: It’s the hottest on the whole Tube system.
ex.t: 这是整个管子系统中最热的。

ex.s: But using machine learning and artificial intelligence, some scientists propose that human diets consist of at least 26,000 biochemicals—and that the vast majority are not known.This shows that we have some way to travel before achieving the first objective of systems t hinking - which,in this example, is to identify more constituent parts of the nutrition system.
ex.t: 但是，利用机器学习和人工智能，一些科学家提出人类饮食至少由26000种生化物质组成——而且绝大多数是未知的。这表明在实现系统思考的第一个目标之前，我们还有一段路要走——在这个例子中，就是识别营养系统的更多组成部分。

ex.s: It would work like this: An officer arriving at the scene of a crash could ask for the phones of the drivers and use the Textalyzer to check in the operating system for recent activity.
ex.t: 它会这样运作：到达车祸现场的警官可以要求司机交出手机，并用Textalyzer在操作系统里检查近期活动。

ex.s: According to systems thinking, changing the food system—or any other network—requires three things to happen.
ex.t: 根据系统思维，改变食物系统——或任何其他网络——需要三件事情发生。

ex.s: First, researchers need to identify all the players in that system; second, they must work out how they relate to each other; and third, they need to understand and quantify the impact of those relationships on each other and on those outside the system.
ex.t: 首先，研究人员需要识别该系统中的所有参与者；其次，他们必须弄清楚彼此之间的关系；第三，他们需要理解和量化这些关系对彼此以及对系统外各方的影响。

ex.s: Dad said she was probably lonely, and that I ought to sit and listen and nod my head and smile, and maybe she’d work it out of her system.
ex.t: 爸爸说她可能很孤独，我应该坐下来倾听、点点头、微笑，也许她能把心里的郁闷发泄出来。

ex.s: Which of the following can replace the underlined phrase “work it out of her system”?
ex.t: 以下哪项可以替换划线短语“work it out of her system”？

ex.s: A systems approach to creating change is also built on the assumption that everyone in the system has equal power.
ex.t: 创造变革的系统方法还建立在一种假设之上，即系统中的每个人都有平等的权力。

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: But however long it takes, the technology has the potential to change our transportation systems and our cities, for better or for worse, depending on how the transformation is regulated.
ex.t: 但无论需要多长时间，这项技术都有潜力改变我们的交通系统和城市，无论是变得更好还是更糟，这取决于这种转型如何被监管。

ex.s: The coming technological advancement presents a chance for cities and states to develop transportation systems designed to move more people, and more affordably.
ex.t: 即将到来的技术进步为城市和各州提供了发展交通系统的机会，这些交通系统旨在以更廉价的方式迁移更多的人。

ex.s: We’re looking at the benefits of systems which control their speed as a way of preventing that.
ex.t: 我们正在研究控制车速的系统的好处，将其作为一种预防措施。"

defs.def: a human or an animal body, or a part of it, when it is being thought of as the organs and processes that make it function 身体；（器官）系统

ex.s: If you haven't been feeling very well, drink some ginger tea to give your immune system a helping hand.
ex.t: 如果你身体一直不太好，喝点姜茶来增强你的免疫系统。

ex.s: When St．Augustine admitted his inability to define time， he highlighted one of time 's most noticeable qualities：Time becomes meaningful only in a defined context．Any timekeeping system is valid，and each is as praiseworthy as its purpose．
ex.t: 当圣奥古斯丁承认自己无法定义时间时，他指出了时间最显著的特性之一：时间只有在特定的语境中才有意义。任何计时系统都是有效的，而每一种都因其用途而值得称赞。

ex.s: I began a second drawer for more general discoveries: new cave system discovered with dozens of nameless species, four hundred species of bacteria found in the human stomach.
ex.t: 我开始了第二个抽屉，用来放更一般的发现：被发现的有几十种无名物种的新洞穴系统、在人体胃部发现的四百种细菌。

ex.s: Every system in our body depends on water to function.
ex.t: 它是为了激励人们更多地了解水相关问题。

defs.def: the rules or people that control a country or an organization, especially when they seem to be unfair because you cannot change them （尤指不公正的统治或管理）制度，体系，集团

ex.s: In a study published in Plant Phenomics, Busch and Pereira establish a new procedure for using SLEAP to analyze plant root phenotypes — how deep and wide they grow, how massive their root systems become, and other physical qualities.
ex.t: 在发表于《Plant Phenomics》的一项研究中，Busch和Pereira建立了一种使用SLEAP分析植物根表型的新流程——包括它们长得有多深多宽、根系变得多庞大，以及其他物理特征。

ex.s: But it's worth remembering that the banking system that we now all live with is just that: A modern invention.
ex.t: 但值得记住的是，我们现在赖以生存的银行体系不过如此：一种现代发明。
